d: Short, layered platinum white hair with choppy bangs and a sleek texture. Large, calm light-blue eyes with a soft expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white and blue technical jacket with a fluffy white fur collar over a black crop top, paired with an asymmetric black stocking and a single black thigh-high strap. Signature details include a blue headset, a large black sword held behind the back, and a heavy white and gold mechanical shield.
